# 貝達國際貿易有限公司 / Besta SV CO.LTD

貝達國際貿易有限公司（Besta SV CO.LTD）提供台灣與越南市場的工業環保工程、空污防治設備、通風工程、集塵系統、VOC 廢氣處理、油煙處理、噴漆漆霧處理、風管工程與工業風機整合服務。

## Core Services

- Industrial air pollution control equipment
- Dust collection systems and bag filter collectors
- VOC exhaust gas treatment and chemical gas treatment
- Oil smoke and kitchen exhaust treatment
- Spray painting booth mist and paint dust treatment
- Factory ventilation and cooling engineering
- Galvanized, stainless steel, and PP plastic duct systems
- Industrial fans, ventilation parts, and environmental equipment integration
